## Checklist

- [ ] `swift format --in-place --recursive .` run (config in `.swift-format`)
- [ ] `swift test --package-path Packages/ReeveCore` is green
- [ ] iOS Simulator + macOS builds succeed (`CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`)
- [ ] Comments explain *why*, not *what*; public/non-obvious API has `///` docs
- [ ] No secrets or personal identifiers committed (placeholders only in examples/tests)
- [ ] Updated docs / `CHANGELOG.md` if behaviour or features changed
